description.p: LinuxPlay connects to another computer's screen over your network with low latency. Video and input travel peer-to-peer over encrypted WebRTC, with hardware H.264, H.265 or AV1 where available.

It picks the best codec, bitrate and framerate for the link and the hardware at both ends, shares each monitor separately, and streams several at once. Install it on the machine you want to control (share its screen) and on the machine you control it from.
From-scratch Rust rewrite: WebRTC transport, per-monitor streaming, automatic quality negotiation, and a Wayland portal host.
